reviews.text: Update 3/16/21. Since a psychedelic ongoing & repeating pattern has been added this app has fallen in it’s appeal and use to me. The pattern has no way to remove it nor turn it off, and if I fall asleep while using it, it drained the battery as if it was running all night! Not a useful feature as most meditation & any rest one might use it for is done with Eyes Closed! At least add an option to turn the pattern Off! I will not be using nor recommending this app to anyone due to this issue. Used to be a great app. *****Original rating: I was struggling to get into doing meditation, but with the help of this app I have been able to progress to doing daily sessions. The different music types help to suit my mood on any particular day, and are instrumental in keeping my focus, as without it my mind tends to wander. The app also provides sleep music that has enabled me to get back into the deep sleep I so desperately need, as I suffer from chronic pain that wakes me throughout the night. So glad I found this, I highly recommend it for everyone! 🙏💕🧘🏼‍♂️
